title: Dev updates reach a user mid-session: a toast with View changes
description: Fabio 2026-10-28: a post (e.g. a release announcement) only showed on the landing bell, so a user in a project never saw it. The feed now polls every 15 min; a post that arrives during the session fires a toast whose one button, View changes, goes to the landing page and opens the Dev updates panel. The app-update check reruns on that arrival so the panel's Update button is current.
